name: SANDJEST Nurse Fuel 40 oz Tumbler with Handle and Straw
seoTitle: Nurse Fuel 40 oz Tumbler with Handle and Straw
metaDescription: A Nurse Fuel 40 oz insulated tumbler with handle and straw for nurses and nursing students who need a big drink to get through a long shift or study day.
summary: A Nurse Fuel 40 oz tumbler with a handle and straw, sized for long shifts and late study nights. A fun pick for nurses and nursing students alike.
whyItWorks: Nurse Fuel says it plainly: this cup is for whatever keeps her going, iced coffee before the morning huddle or plain water during clinicals. A 40 oz size means fewer refills, which matters when breaks are short and the water fountain is down the hall. The straw lets her sip quickly at the station without unscrewing a lid, and the handle makes it easy to carry along with a backpack or a work bag.

Nursing students are a great audience for this one. Between lectures, skills labs, clinical days, and long study sessions, a giant cup becomes a constant companion. It also makes a cheerful graduation gift for a new grad headed into her first year on the floor. For a working nurse, it fits right into Nurses Week or a birthday, and it pairs nicely with a bag of good coffee or a favorite drink mix.
goodToKnow: A 40 oz cup is large, so check the listing dimensions if she has a small car cup holder.
Check the listing for care instructions, including dishwasher guidance for the lid and straw.
Some units limit drinks at the station, so it may live in the break room during shifts.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes, students spend long days in class and clinicals, and a big insulated cup helps them stay hydrated and caffeinated. The Nurse Fuel design fits student life well.

faq.q: Does it come with a straw?
faq.a: The title lists a handle and straw. Check the listing for the lid style and any extra straws.
